latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of de-video — AI-powered video removal and processing.

- Upload raw video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB), describe your edits, and get back a 1080p MP4 ready to post.
- Supports background removal, silence cutting, exporting audio-only, and more via simple natural language commands.
- Automatic setup and authentication, with free credits for new users.
- Fast cloud rendering pipeline (30–90 sec typical), with clear status updates and error handling.
- Workflow includes upload, edit via chat, and easy export/download of processed videos.
- Suitable for content creators who want quick, no-skill-required video cleanup.
